clarity.description: Is the phrase instantly readable and understood? No ambiguity.

rubric.18-20: Crystal clear — anyone gets it in under 2 seconds

texas_ness.description: Does it feel genuinely Texas? Not generic Americana — specifically Texas.

rubric.18-20: Unmistakably Texas — locals will immediately claim it
rubric.10-13: Some Texas flavor but could be anywhere

humor_punch.description: Does it make someone smirk, chuckle, or nod? Edge without offense.

rubric.18-20: Genuinely funny — will make someone show their friend
rubric.0-4: Not funny at all or offensive

wearability.description: Would real people actually wear this in public? Not just buy it.

rubric.14-17: Very wearable for the target audience

print_simplicity.description: Can this be screen-printed in 1–4 spot colors with clean lines?

rubric.18-20: Born for screen print — bold, minimal, iconic
rubric.14-17: Clean enough for 2-3 color screen print
